brand.pitch: Turn announcements, emails and vague goals into clear deadlines, measurable checkpoints and steady progress.

capture.title: Smart Capture
capture.body: Paste long text. Review the deadlines, deliverables and requirements it finds.

deadlines.title: Unambiguous deadlines
deadlines.body: Exact times with time zones, live countdowns and honest risk levels.

checkpoints.title: Measurable checkpoints
checkpoints.body: Break big work into verifiable steps you approve before they are saved.

goals.title: Flexible goals
goals.body: Track quantities, hours or milestones, with or without a target date.

search.hint: Type to search. Press Enter to open.
